verses.text: Then Zophar replied,
“I am very perturbed about what you have said,
By saying these things you have insulted me,
“Do you not know that from long ago,
wicked people like you do not continue to rejoice for a long time,
Even though their reputation/pride reaches up to the sky
they will disappear forever, like their own dung,
They will be forgotten like [SIM] a dream is,
Those who saw those people previously will never see them again;
Their children will be forced to return the valuable things that those children stole from poor people [DOU].
Previously their bodies were young and strong,
“Doing wicked things was like having sweet food in their mouths,
And they did not want to stop doing those things,
but some day the evil things that they enjoyed doing will become like food that they swallow
Wicked people will not continue to keep the money they have accumulated,
What wicked people do is like [MET] swallowing snake venom;
They will not remain alive to see abundant blessings [IDM] from God, milk and olive oil and honey,
They will be forced to give back the things that they stole from the poor;
because they oppressed poor people and refused to help them,
“They were always greedy and never satisfied.
When they finished eating their food, there was never anything left over because they had greedily eaten it all;
When they are extremely prosperous/wealthy,
When the wicked people are filling their stomachs,
They will try to escape from being killed by iron weapons,
The arrows will go completely through their bodies and stick out of their backs;
Their valuable possessions will all be destroyed;
The angels in heaven [MTY] will reveal the sins that those wicked people have committed,
When God punishes [MTY] people,
That is what will happen to wicked people like you;
